purpose: Central register of municipalities with known follow-up work from completed legal-review batches. This file is additive: a municipality is removed from openItems only after its named nextAction has been completed and QA-checked.

statusDefinitions.deep-review-required: Current sources exist, but a complex municipality/topic needs article-level consolidation before product encoding.
statusDefinitions.address-check-required: Legal framework is known but outcome depends on BAG/address, area, building, quota or Omgevingsplan.
statusDefinitions.targeted-research-required: One or more specific current legal topics remain unconfirmed after research/retest.
statusDefinitions.product-signoff-required: Research is substantively complete enough for implementation review, but no definitive automated legal conclusion may yet be published.
